 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. ESPN 's "College GameDay" was in Florida in Week 12 for an ACC matchup between No. 5 Miami Hurricanes and the unranked Virginia Tech Hokies. Miami has dominated the rivalry historically and recently. The Hurricanes have won nine of the last 11 games.
 The Hurricanes are 9-1 and should ensure their spot in the College Football Playoff with a win tonight. The game is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET on ESPN. Until then, fans are just hanging out on campus watching Pat McAfee in a Speedo, which should make for some interesting signs in the future.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For now though, here's what Miami fans cooked up for this "GameDay" visit.
 MORE: College football games on today, Friday night TV schedule for Week 12 
 Best "College GameDay" signs from the University of Miami
 College football may take place (mostly) on Saturday, but clearly some people are still in work mode. Like this Miami fan who thinks a game against an unranked opponent is such a formality that it could have just been an e-mail.
 The most topical signs of the day obviously involved GTA VI . Multiple people in Miami actually put down the controllers, made some signs and probably left the house for the first time in days. What else besides college football could do that?
 This sign points out the fact that Miami has won the last five games in this matchup. When the Hokies last won, in 2019, Malachi Toney was 12. Toney only threw one pass and carried the ball three times when Miami won, 34-17, last season. Carson Beck started and threw for 320 yards and four touchdowns.
